title: OpenCV 5 hype-check: the CPU-only catch nobody mentions #EdgeAI #DevTools
description:
OpenCV 5 honest hype-check: the new DNN engine, ONNX Runtime speed, and the CPU-only catch. OpenCV called v5 "the biggest leap in years" — Hacker News called the announcement AI slop. Strip the wording and the numbers are real: ONNX operator coverage jumps from ~22% to over 80%, YOLOv8 runs ~11% faster, XFeat ~31% — but the fast new engine is CPU-only, and the bundled models are a year+ old. So is it a real leap, or just catching up to ONNX Runtime?
